subject: Vitalslice performance bench — sync & reschedule request
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightbyte.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@quilton.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Vitalslice perf bench — initial ask

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. BrightByte would like to run a focused throughput/latency review with Redwood to validate our production targets before committing to Dedicated.

High-level asks:
- Confirm sustained token throughput target: ~2.5M tokens/min for mixed-chat workload (50/30/20 split short/medium/long).
- P50 latency goal: <= 120ms; P95 under 350ms.
- Understand batching/caching options that keep CPU/GPU utilization reasonable.

Can we schedule a technical deep-dive this week? We prefer US mornings (10–12 PT) or EU afternoons (15–17 CET). I've attached a short throughput worksheet.

If you want to invite Marcus or Aditya for runtime/kernel questions, please do.

—Alex
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightbyte.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Vitalslice perf bench — initial ask

Alex —

Thanks. Marcus and Aditya are available for a deep-dive. Laura (product) should join to align on SLA language; looping her in.

Quick notes after scanning your worksheet: the 2.5M tok/min target is achievable in our Dedicated path but we need to validate with a dry run at 75% sustained concurrency to hit your p95. Proposed agenda (45–60m):
1) Workload profile & token distribution (you)
2) Serving architecture options & quantization profiles (Marcus)
3) Dry-run plan and telemetry expectations (Aditya)
4) Rollout/fallback strategy + next steps (Irene/Laura)

I'm free Fri 10/2 10:30–11:30 PT or Mon 10/5 10:00–11:00 PT. Which works?

Irene
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightbyte.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 12:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Vitalslice perf bench — initial ask

Irene —

Thanks for the clear agenda. Friday 10/2 10:30 PT works for us. One ask: can you include a short pre-read that lists the exact metrics Redwood will capture during the dry run (e.g., token/s, GPU util, context-switch latency, KV cache hit rate)? That will help our infra team prep access.

I'll send calendar invite and include our ops contact (ops@quilton.ai).

—Alex

We can accommodate 10:15 PT Friday but need to tighten the runbook: Marcus and Aditya will prepare a 15-min architecture readout that explicitly calls out kernel/quantization choices and the expected perf delta. Laura will circulate the telemetry pre-read by EOD Thursday.

- BrightByte: confirm workload trace or representative sample (s3 link or synthetic trace) by Thu EOD (Alex).
- Redwood: share dry-run matrix and telemetry list (Laura) by Thu EOD.
- Redwood infra: prepare a short appendix on expected p50/p95 at 2.5M tok/min under target batching (Marcus/Aditya).
